create_VideoManager: create a VideoManager instance to read frames from a video file or webcam for inference
create_ThreadVideoManager: create a ThreadVideoManager instance to read and display video frames using multithreading
run_VideoManager_next: run VideoManager iteration to retrieve sequential clips of frames for model inference
run_ThreadVideoManager_start: start ThreadVideoManager threads to concurrently read frames and display or write output video
test_VideoManager_display: test VideoManager display method to show frames in a window or write them to an output video file
